newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European countries so far do not want to intervene militarily in Albania.
-- Parliamentarians estimate alleged misuse of corporate funds at Credit Lyonnais at up to five billion francs.
-- Forum on European energy supply raises worries about possible energy shortage in Europe as some supplier countries are in an unstable political condition.
-- Workers from Renault plant of Vilvorde, Belgium, which is to be shut down, demonstrate at Douai Renault plant against job cuts.
